"""New independent r4 probes; security expectations, not worker-selected cases."""
import dataclasses,json,threading
import psycopg,pytest
from agent_guard.contracts.execution import ExecutionError,ToolId,TerminalAction

from agent_guard.tools import results

from agent_guard.ledger import store as ls
from agent_guard.execution import store as es
from agent_guard.execution.service import ExecutionService
from agent_guard.ledger.migrate import apply_migrations,DEFAULT_MIGRATIONS_DIR
from agent_guard.ledger.service import ExecutionLedger

@pytest.mark.parametrize('field',['quote_id','quote_version','supplier_id','sku'])
def test_snapshot_identifier_trailing_lf_refused(field):
 obj={'quote_id':'quote-001','quote_version':'1','supplier_id':'supplier-001','items':[{'sku':'sku-001','quantity':1,'unit_price_fen':70000}],'total_fen':70000,'currency':'CNY'}
 if field=='sku':obj['items'][0]['sku']+='\n'
 else:obj[field]+='\n'
 error=None
 try:snapshot_from_bytes(json.dumps(obj).encode())
 except ExecutionError as exc:error=exc.code.value
 observe('r4-trailing-LF-snapshot',{'field':field,'error':error})
 assert error=='LEGACY_SNAPSHOT_INVALID'

@pytest.mark.parametrize('entry',['run','reconcile','candidate','fallback','helper'])
def test_deep_legacy_params_durably_isolated(a2,monkeypatch,entry):
 raw=b'{"request_id":'+b'['*1500+b'0'+b']'*1500+b'}'
 op=a2.ledger.accept(a2.tree.invocation(idempotency_key='deep-params',tool_id=ToolId.REQUEST_READ.value,params=raw),TrustedCost(0,1)).operation_id
 before=counters(a2);proofs=fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)['ag_proofs'];error=None
 if entry=='fallback':
  original=a2.service._find_candidate; calls=[]
  def find(v):calls.append(1);return None if len(calls)==1 else original(v)
  monkeypatch.setattr(a2.service,'_find_candidate',find);a2.catalog.remove_request('req-001')
 try:
  if entry=='run':a2.service.run_operation(op)
  elif entry=='reconcile':a2.service.reconcile(op)
  elif entry=='helper':a2.service.quarantine_if_insufficient(op)
  else:a2.service.accept_invocation(a2.tree.invocation(idempotency_key='deep-params',tool_id=ToolId.REQUEST_READ.value,params=read_params()),a2.permission())
 except Exception as exc:error=exc.code.value if isinstance(exc,ExecutionError) else type(exc).__name__
 observe('r4-deep-legacy-params',{'entry':entry,'error':error,'flag':a2.service.review_flag(op) is not None,'before':before,'after':counters(a2),'effects':effects(a2),'proofs_before':proofs,'proofs_after':fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)['ag_proofs']})
 assert a2.service.review_flag(op) is not None
 assert error in ('LEGACY_SNAPSHOT_INVALID',None) and counters(a2)==before and effects(a2)['ds_operations']==0

@pytest.mark.parametrize('entry',['run','reconcile'])
def test_legacy_supplier_trailing_lf_isolated_without_call(a2,entry):
 snap=a2.catalog.build_order_snapshot(tenant_id=a2.tree.tenant_id,task_id=a2.tree.task_id,request_id='req-001',quote_id='quote-001',quote_version='1',items=(('sku-001',1),),delivery_id='office-001')
 raw=snapshot_to_bytes(dataclasses.replace(snap,supplier_id='supplier-001\n'))
 op=a2.ledger.accept(a2.tree.invocation(idempotency_key='lf-supplier',tool_id=ToolId.ORDER_CREATE.value,params=order_params()),TrustedCost(70000,quote_id='quote-001',quote_version='1',quote_snapshot=raw)).operation_id
 before=counters(a2);error=None;returned=None
 try:returned=a2.service.run_operation(op) if entry=='run' else a2.service.reconcile(op)
 except ExecutionError as exc:error=exc.code.value
 observe('r4-legacy-lf',{'entry':entry,'error':error,'returned':None if returned is None else returned.status,'flag':a2.service.review_flag(op) is not None,'before':before,'after':counters(a2),'effects':effects(a2)})
 assert error=='LEGACY_SNAPSHOT_INVALID' and a2.service.review_flag(op) is not None and counters(a2)==before and effects(a2)['ds_operations']==0

@pytest.mark.parametrize('entry',['execute','query'])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('mutation',['items-none','item-dict','items-list','effect-lf','version-zero'])
def test_outcome_typed_and_id_boundaries_keep_unknown(a2,entry,mutation):
 op=accepted(a2).operation_id;row=a2.service.load_operation(op)
 v=a2.downstream.execute(service_secret=a2.secret,operation_id=op,tool_id=ToolId.ORDER_CREATE,canonical_params=row.canonical_params,quote=snapshot_from_bytes(row.quote_snapshot),expected_amount_fen=70000)
 if mutation=='items-none':v=dataclasses.replace(v,quote=dataclasses.replace(v.quote,items=None))
 if mutation=='item-dict':v=dataclasses.replace(v,quote=dataclasses.replace(v.quote,items=(dataclasses.asdict(v.quote.items[0]),)))
 if mutation=='items-list':v=dataclasses.replace(v,quote=dataclasses.replace(v.quote,items=list(v.quote.items)))
 if mutation=='effect-lf':
  obj=json.loads(v.result_bytes);obj['order_id']+='\n';v=dataclasses.replace(v,effect_ref=obj['order_id'],result_bytes=json.dumps(obj).encode())
 if mutation=='version-zero':
  obj=json.loads(v.result_bytes);obj['quote_version']='0';v=dataclasses.replace(v,result_bytes=json.dumps(obj).encode())
 class Port:
  def execute(self,**kw):return v
  def query(self,**kw):return v
 env=build_env(tree=a2.tree,gateway_dsn=a2.gateway_dsn,downstream_dsn=a2.downstream_dsn,downstream=Port())
 r=None;error=None
 try:r=env.service.run_operation(op) if entry=='execute' else env.service.reconcile(op)
 except Exception as exc:error=type(exc).__name__
 observe('r4-outcome-boundary',{'entry':entry,'mutation':mutation,'error':error,'reported':None if r is None else r.status,'persisted':env.service.operation_status(op),'outbox':env.service.outbox_entry(op) is not None,'counters':counters(a2),'effects':effects(a2)})
 if mutation=='items-list':
  assert error is None and r.status=='SUCCEEDED' and env.service.outbox_entry(op) is not None
  assert effects(a2)['ds_orders']==1
  assert all(c=={'amount_reserved':0,'amount_settled':70000,'calls_reserved':0,'calls_settled':1} for c in counters(a2))
 else:
  assert error is None and r.status=='UNKNOWN' and env.service.outbox_entry(op) is None
  assert all(c['amount_reserved']==70000 and c['amount_settled']==0 for c in counters(a2))

@pytest.mark.parametrize('entry',['run','reconcile'])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('newstate',['terminal','live-owner'])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('round_no',range(10))
def test_public_unknown_stale_query_accurate(a2,entry,newstate,round_no):
 op=accepted(a2).operation_id;assert a2.service.reconcile(op,owner_token='initial').status=='UNKNOWN';expire_lease(a2.gateway_dsn,op)
 ready=threading.Event();release=threading.Event();errors=[];returned=[]
 class Port:
  def query(self,**kw):ready.set();assert release.wait(15);return None
  def execute(self,**kw):return None
 env=build_env(tree=a2.tree,gateway_dsn=a2.gateway_dsn,downstream_dsn=a2.downstream_dsn,downstream=Port())
 def old():
  try:returned.append(env.service.run_operation(op,owner_token='old') if entry=='run' else env.service.reconcile(op,owner_token='old'))
  except Exception as exc:errors.append(exc.code.value if isinstance(exc,ExecutionError) else type(exc).__name__)
 t=threading.Thread(target=old);t.start();assert ready.wait(10);expire_lease(a2.gateway_dsn,op)
 if newstate=='terminal':assert a2.service.run_operation(op,owner_token='new').status=='SUCCEEDED'
 else:a2.service._claim(op,'new')
 release.set();t.join(20);assert not t.is_alive()
 observe('r4-public-stale-unknown',{'entry':entry,'newstate':newstate,'round':round_no,'errors':errors,'returned':[r.status for r in returned],'persisted':a2.service.operation_status(op),'counters':counters(a2),'effects':effects(a2),'outbox':a2.service.outbox_entry(op) is not None})
 assert errors==(['ILLEGAL_TRANSITION'] if newstate=='terminal' else ['LEASE_LOST']) and not returned
 assert fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)['ag_receipt_outbox']==(1 if newstate=='terminal' else 0)

@pytest.mark.parametrize('illegal',[False,True])
def test_005_to_006_seven_tables_and_full_registry(namespace,tmp_path,illegal):
 db=create_scratch_database(namespace.base_dsn)
 try:
  old=tmp_path/'pre003';old.mkdir();pre005=tmp_path/'pre005';pre005.mkdir()
  for p in sorted(DEFAULT_MIGRATIONS_DIR.glob('*.sql')):
   if p.name[:3]<='003':(old/p.name).write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
   if p.name[:3]<='005':(pre005/p.name).write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
  with psycopg.connect(db.dsn) as c:apply_migrations(c,old);tree=build_tree(c)
  op=ExecutionLedger(db.dsn).accept(tree.invocation(),tree.cost(70000)).operation_id
  with psycopg.connect(db.dsn) as c:
   revoke_grant(c,tree.mid_id)
   if illegal:
    other=build_tree(c,tenant_id='other-tenant')
    c.execute('UPDATE ag_ledger_event_nodes SET grant_id=%s WHERE event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM ag_ledger_events WHERE operation_id=%s) AND position=2',(other.leaf_id,op))
  with psycopg.connect(db.dsn) as c:assert apply_migrations(c,pre005)==['004','005']
  before=db_snapshot(db.dsn);assert all(before[0].values())
  if illegal:
   with psycopg.connect(db.dsn) as c:
    with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.CheckViolation,match='006 pre-check'):apply_migrations(c)
   assert db_snapshot(db.dsn)==before
   with psycopg.connect(db.dsn) as c:assert c.execute("SELECT to_regclass('ag_event_seals')").fetchone()[0] is None
  else:
   with psycopg.connect(db.dsn) as c:assert apply_migrations(c)==['006']
   after=db_snapshot(db.dsn);assert after[0]==before[0] and after[1][:-1]==before[1]
   with psycopg.connect(db.dsn) as c:assert apply_migrations(c)==[]
   assert db_snapshot(db.dsn)==after
  observe('r4-upgrade005',{'illegal':illegal,'seven_full_rows_equal':True,'registry_preserved':True})
 finally:drop_scratch_database(namespace.base_dsn,db)

@pytest.mark.parametrize('phase',['RESERVE','SETTLE'])
def test_old_short_event_seal_forgery_concurrent_denied(a2,namespace,tmp_path,phase):
 from tests.integration.test_execution_r3_regressions import _seed_short_event
 db,env,tree,op=_seed_short_event(a2,namespace,tmp_path,phase)
 try:
  with psycopg.connect(db.dsn) as c:
   assert apply_migrations(c)==['005','006'];eid=c.execute('SELECT event_id FROM ag_ledger_events WHERE operation_id=%s AND phase=%s',(op,phase)).fetchone()[0]
  before=db_snapshot(db.dsn);box=env.service.outbox_entry(op)
  barrier=threading.Barrier(2);errors=[]
  def forge():
   try:
    with psycopg.connect(db.dsn) as c:
     barrier.wait(10);c.execute('INSERT INTO ag_event_seals VALUES (%s,pg_current_xact_id()::text)',(eid,))
   except Exception as exc:errors.append((type(exc).__name__,getattr(exc,'sqlstate',None)))
  for _ in range(10):
   errors.clear();ts=[threading.Thread(target=forge) for _ in range(2)]
   for t in ts:t.start()
   for t in ts:t.join(15)
   assert not any(t.is_alive() for t in ts) and sorted(errors)==[('CheckViolation','23514')]*2
  with psycopg.connect(db.dsn) as c:
   assert c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM ag_event_seals WHERE event_id=%s',(eid,)).fetchone()[0]==0
   with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.CheckViolation,match='current transaction'):
    with c.transaction():c.execute('INSERT INTO ag_event_seals VALUES (%s,%s)',(eid,'wrong-xid'))
  assert db_snapshot(db.dsn)==before and env.service.outbox_entry(op)==box
  observe('r4-old-seal-forge',{'phase':phase,'rounds':10,'concurrent_refusals':20,'all_old_rows_and_registry_equal':True,'outbox_equal':True})
 finally:drop_scratch_database(namespace.base_dsn,db)

def test_savepoint_seal_does_not_escape_and_retry_legitimate(a2):
 op=accepted(a2).operation_id;before=fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)
 with psycopg.connect(a2.gateway_dsn) as c:
  with c.transaction():
   c.execute('SAVEPOINT r4')
   eid=c.execute("INSERT INTO ag_ledger_events(operation_id,phase,seq) VALUES(%s,'RELEASE',1) RETURNING event_id",(op,)).fetchone()[0]
   assert c.execute('SELECT created_xid=pg_current_xact_id()::text FROM ag_event_seals WHERE event_id=%s',(eid,)).fetchone()==(True,)
   c.execute('ROLLBACK TO r4')
   assert c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM ag_event_seals WHERE event_id=%s',(eid,)).fetchone()==(0,)
 assert fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)==before
 assert a2.service.run_operation(op).status=='SUCCEEDED'
 assert effects(a2)['ds_orders']==1 and fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)['ag_receipt_outbox']==1
 observe('r4-savepoint-seal',{'rolled_back_seal':True,'legitimate_retry':True})

def test_last_candidate_miss_race_must_verify_before_existing(a2,monkeypatch):
 # Commit a competing A1 accepted fact AFTER A2 last read miss, BEFORE A1 decides.
 ready=threading.Event();committed=threading.Event();errors=[];op=[]
 original=a2.ledger.accept_checked
 def delayed(v,c,*,existing_validator,**kwargs):ready.set();assert committed.wait(10);return original(v,c,existing_validator=existing_validator,**kwargs)
 monkeypatch.setattr(a2.ledger,'accept_checked',delayed)
 def legacy_accept():
  try:
   assert ready.wait(10)
   op.append(ExecutionLedger(a2.gateway_dsn).accept(a2.tree.invocation(idempotency_key='last-miss',tool_id=ToolId.ORDER_CREATE.value,params=order_params()),TrustedCost(70000,quote_id='quote-001',quote_version='1',quote_snapshot=b'invalid legacy material')).operation_id)
  except Exception as exc:errors.append(type(exc).__name__)
  finally:committed.set()
 t=threading.Thread(target=legacy_accept);t.start();error=None;returned=None
 try:returned=a2.service.accept_invocation(a2.tree.invocation(idempotency_key='last-miss',tool_id=ToolId.ORDER_CREATE.value,params=order_params()),a2.permission())
 except Exception as exc:error=exc.code.value if isinstance(exc,ExecutionError) else type(exc).__name__
 t.join(15);assert not t.is_alive() and not errors and len(op)==1
 observe('r4-last-candidate-miss',{'error':error,'returned':None if returned is None else returned.disposition.value,'flag':a2.service.review_flag(op[0]) is not None,'proofs':fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)['ag_proofs'],'counters':counters(a2),'effects':effects(a2)})
 assert error=='LEGACY_SNAPSHOT_INVALID' and a2.service.review_flag(op[0]) is not None and fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)['ag_proofs']==1

def test_formal_reverse_efficacy_cannot_pass_without_target_interleaving(a2,monkeypatch):
 from tests.integration.test_execution_regressions import test_lock_regression_reverse_efficacy_requires_a_real_deadlock
 # Explicitly serialize after the before-first-lock barrier. No lock inversion exists.
 final_done=threading.Event();errors=[];realop=es.lock_operation;realfinal=ExecutionService._finalize;realclaim=es.claim_lease
 def op(c,*a,**kw):
  if threading.current_thread().name=='claim':assert final_done.wait(15)
  return realop(c,*a,**kw)
 def final(self,*a,**kw):
  try:return realfinal(self,*a,**kw)
  finally:final_done.set()
 def claim(*a,**kw):
  try:return realclaim(*a,**kw)
  except Exception as exc:errors.append(exc.code.value if isinstance(exc,ExecutionError) else type(exc).__name__);raise
 monkeypatch.setattr(es,'lock_operation',op);monkeypatch.setattr(ExecutionService,'_finalize',final);monkeypatch.setattr(es,'claim_lease',claim)
 error=None
 try:test_lock_regression_reverse_efficacy_requires_a_real_deadlock(a2,monkeypatch)
 except AssertionError:error='AssertionError'
 observe('r4-formal-reverse-efficacy',{'formal_rejected_serialized_non_trigger':error is not None,'claim_errors':errors,'outbox':fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)['ag_receipt_outbox'],'effects':effects(a2)})
 assert error=='AssertionError', 'formal efficacy passes from a normal terminal-state refusal, without any lock overlap'

@pytest.mark.parametrize('inject',['exception','no-progress'])
def test_formal_lock_regression_rejects_thread_error_and_no_progress(a2,monkeypatch,inject):
 from tests.integration.test_execution_regressions import test_claim_and_finalize_interleaved_never_deadlock
 if inject=='exception':
  real=ls.lock_task
  def task(*a,**kw):
   if threading.current_thread().name=='claim':raise RuntimeError('owned deliberate efficacy failure')
   return real(*a,**kw)
  monkeypatch.setattr(ls,'lock_task',task)
 else:
  real=ExecutionService._finalize
  def final(self,*a,**kw):
   if threading.current_thread().name=='final':return None
   return real(self,*a,**kw)
  monkeypatch.setattr(ExecutionService,'_finalize',final)
 with pytest.raises(AssertionError):test_claim_and_finalize_interleaved_never_deadlock(a2,monkeypatch)
 observe('r4-formal-negative-efficacy',{'injection':inject,'formal_fails':True})
